newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHENS INAUGURATES ELYTIS STATUE IN KOLONAKI.
newsitem.headline: ATHENS INAUGURATES ELYTIS STATUE IN KOLONAKI.

text.p: One year after the death of Nobel laureate poet Odysseas Elytis, Athens inaugurated a memorial statue by sculptor Yannis Pappas at Dexameni place in Kolonaki, the mayor's office said on Monday.
"Elytis was the living conscience of Hellenism. As he used to say 'poetry cannot change the world because the world changes through action'," mayor Dimitris Avramopoulos said during the ceremony.
But poetry may change people's conscience and through their actions they may change the world, he said.
"It is towards this Greece, with more light, that people look to when visiting the poetry of Elytis."
